name: Polina Malinovskaya career
content: Polina Malinovskaya's career highlights: Model and influencer; campaigns for Guess, Calvin Klein, Tommy Hilfiger, and L'Oreal; Signed with a Milan agency at 15 with her father's help; Ask.fm star (35,000+ questions answered) before Instagram fame

name: Polina Malinovskaya personal
content: About Polina Malinovskaya: Born June 23, 1998 in Belarus, raised in Italy; speaks Russian, English, Italian, and some Belarusian. Danced ballet for 8 years; loves yoga, Pilates, and stretching; dreams of opening an animal charity.

name: Polina Malinovskaya quotes
content: Things Polina Malinovskaya has said: I'm very shy as person, even if you can't say so from my feed on Instagram. | It's good to show people that it's okay to fail, that it's normal to fail. The most important thing is to not give up on your dreams.

name: Polina Malinovskaya voice
content: Polina Malinovskaya's speaking style: Sweet, candid, and self-aware in her Naluda interview — describes herself as shy despite her Instagram persona, funny about bizarre DMs, and warmly grateful about her dad. Multilingual European charm.
